android.desc:
Your friends know you better than any AI ever will. That's why their recommendations are so valuable. Remember this situation? A friend told you about a movie you should watch, but you didn't write it down and forgot about it. The next time you want to watch a movie, you end up choosing one recommended by Netflix.

Listo to the rescue! Instead of recommending stuff in person or via messenger, have your friends send it to you on Listo. The next time you want to watch a movie, just open Listo and see a well-organized list of personal recommendations.

Listo supports movies, TV shows, podcasts, music, Youtube and books.


Listo is simple: Create an account, add a contact, search for a movie and send it to the contact. That's it!

Features:
- Powerful search: Search movies and TV shows, music (artists, albums, songs), books, YouTube, podcasts directly within Listo and send it to your friends.
- Share from other apps like Spotify or YouTube to Listo to send it to your friends.
- Get notifications when your friends watched/read/checked your recommendation.
- Filter movies and tv shows by availability on Netflix, Amazon, iTunes and other streaming providers.

This is a passionate side-project by a small team. We'd love to hear your feedback and ideas!
Please contact us at: mail@listo.social

Your Listo Team

quotes.text:
Proud to be on HN!

we are unhappy with the information flow in current social media, like Facebook and twitter. We found that the problem lies in the follower-concept itself. By default, everyone shares content with ALL their followers. That way there is too much content that isn't tailored to the preferences of the user - the signal to noise ratio is very low. Therefore, most content in my stream is irrelevant to me.

Our goal, through Listo, is to turn this around and make sharing and recommendations personal again. We want to enable a much higher recommendation quality than current social media systems can offer.

Our idea is very simple, but the consequences are profound. It boils down to this:

Let your friends add items to your reading, movies, and music lists all in one space.

This is in fact very similar to what is already happening today. People are sending you personal recommendations about HN articles, books or movies via email/WhatsApp. But you have to add them to your reading list yourself, otherwise they will get lost in several chat histories. We created an app for this use-case, that requires zero discipline from your side: Let your friends put interesting articles and books directly into your personal reading list. Let them put movies, tv shows and youtube videos into your watchlist. The same goes for music, podcasts and anything else.

quotes.story_title: Show HN: Listo – Your Social Watchlist

quotes.text:
Hello HN!

We made an app to remove personal recommendations from communication channels and provide a social read-it-later solution instead.

A challenge we are facing right now is to find out how we can make the product more viral. Users can already use the app to send content to non-users but few actually do.

Any insights on this topic would be greatly appreciated.

The app is developed with Flutter/Firebase and available in Play Store and App Store.

Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.listo

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1502284126

We're looking forward to hearing your thoughts and questions!
quotes.story_title: Show HN: Let your friends add articles to your reading list
